st: Detective Defford searches Jessica's office over Carl Nussbaumer's murder, questions Trish, and helps arrest Jessica at gunpoint.

files.notes: Named on screen: Imada says 'That's Detective Defford' (S3E9) and introduces them both to Trish (S3E11). The arrest ends S3E10 and is shown again in S3E11, which also shows the funeral home questioning, so the step ends in 11.

st: Detective Imada leads the Nussbaumer murder case against Jessica and arrests her, then frees her when the killer strikes again.

files.notes: Says 'I'm Detective Imada' (S3E9). Releases Jessica at the start of S3E12.

st: Dwayne drops Erik into his mother's pool tied to weights, until a masked Trish beats him and his mother is badly hurt.

files.notes: Only 'Dwayne' is said on screen (S3E4: 'Dwayne, honey', 'Dwayne! My baby!'); the surname is his mother Sal Blaskowski's, so n is Dwayne. Sal's bookmaking operation has no on-screen name: Independent.

add.k: The Jones family's old next-door neighbor
st: Mrs. De Luca gossips with Jessica and Kilgrave over breakfast, then, under his control, hands Simpson his bomb and blows herself up.

files.notes: Introduces herself: 'I'm Elizabeth De Luca' (S1E8). No group: Independent.

n: A married woman at Luke's bar
add.k: A married woman having an affair with Luke
st: Gina sleeps with Luke, learns Jessica photographed them, and her husband Andre sends his rugby team to beat Luke.

files.notes: Seen with Luke in S1E1 unnamed; Jessica names her 'Gina' in S1E2. No group: Independent.

add.k: A pimp who runs Brianna on the street
st: Gor takes Brianna's cut and punches Malcolm to drag her back to the street, until Malcolm beats him down and takes her.

files.notes: Named by Brianna ('Gor', S3E5). Works for himself: Independent.

add.k: Trish's on-air partner on her ARN style show
st: Grace co-hosts Trish's style program, smooths over her odd moments on air, and comforts her after Dorothy's murder.

files.notes: Only 'Grace' is said (Dorothy, S3E2; Trish, S3E4 and S3E8); the surname Bennett is never said, so n is Grace. The program airs on ARN ('available right here on ARN', S3E3), mapped to the app's 'ARN TV'.

add.k: A club owner dodging a lawsuit subpoena
st: Spheeris dodges a subpoena over an injured dancer until Jessica lifts his car, serves him, and shrugs off his threat to expose her.

files.notes: Named repeatedly in S1E1; only mentioned in S1E4 (Audrey Eastman). His club is unnamed: Independent. Raft because he threatens to expose Jessica; could be a Compound bystander instead.

st: Reporter Griffin dates Trish, copies her IGH list, and stages a surprise proposal, but she breaks up with him and he heads to Syria.

files.notes: 'Griffin Sinclair!' said in S2E1; last seen reporting from Aleppo on TV in S2E9. ZCN is mentioned only as people he knows ('Let me talk to the guys at ZCN'), not as his employer, and the wiki's military past is really news assignments, so Independent.

add.k: A former IGH nurse living on the street
st: Former IGH nurse Inez tells Jessica about the clinic, cons Jeri into freeing Shane, robs her, then shoots Shane on Jeri's lies.

files.notes: 'Inez Green' said in S2E4; she says 'I was a nurse' at IGH. Raft because she cons and robs Jeri. After she shoots Shane, Jeri calls 911 but no arrest is shown (wiki says in custody), so At large.

add.k: A developer who burns down his own buildings
st: Developer Jace Montero, one of Erik's blackmail marks, admits his fires killed 14 people before the masked Trish beats him to death.

files.notes: Named in S3E10 (Malcolm phones him off screen); on screen only in S3E11. His company is never named on screen: Independent.

add.k: An EMT whose kidneys Kilgrave took
st: Mute after Kilgrave took his kidneys, Jack spells out KIL for Jessica, then writes a plea for her to kill him.

files.notes: Jessica says 'I'm looking for Jack Denton' (S1E2). His ambulance employer is never named in his scenes: Independent.

add.k: A hosiery heir who pays Karl Malus's bills
st: Justis, whose son Malus saved, refuses to give Malus up and warns him, until Jessica corners his son and he gives in.

files.notes: Named in S2E6 ('Justis Ambrose', 'Ambyhose Hosiery Inc... Run by this guy'). Compound as a protective father rather than a threat.

add.k: A hospital security guard and Patsy fan
st: Hospital guard Kyle trades a copied hospital file on Jessica for Trish singing at his daughter's birthday party.

files.notes: His husband Ash says 'Kyle' (S2E1). The hospital is not named in his scene: Independent.

st: After his father's suicide, Laurent shoves Jeri to the ground, then later comes to her firm to ask help for his mother Kith.

files.notes: Introduces himself 'Laurent' (S3E6); 'It's Laurent Lyonne' (S3E9). Mentioned but not seen in S3E5 and S3E10. His school is unnamed: Independent.

add.k: A loan shark hunting Antoine Grier
st: Loan shark Sirkes cuts a finder's deal with Luke and Jessica for Antoine, then fights them for him at the weed warehouse.

files.notes: Only 'Sirkes' is said (S1E6); 'Len' is never said, so n is Sirkes. His crew is unnamed: Independent.

k: A doctor tied to IGH, missing for years
An IGH doctor who treated Alisa
st: Dr. Leslie Hansen brings Alisa to IGH and doubts Malus's methods; years later her burned head turns up in a furnace.

files.notes: Named in S2E3 ('Dr. Leslie Hansen worked at Metro-General in the 90s'), head identified at the end of S2E3; alive in the S2E7 IGH scenes ('Dr. Leslie Hansen, trauma surgeon'). ep is 7 so the IGH part is not spoiled. Who killed her is not stated on screen, so not used. No Alisa tie: their only bond is doctor and patient.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Detectives Defford and Imada work the Nussbaumer murder together, searching Jessica's office and questioning Trish. Imada reins Defford in when Jessica attacks Nussbaumer's record, and they arrest Jessica together.
stages.whoA: Her partner on the Nussbaumer case
stages.whoB: Her partner on the Nussbaumer case

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Defford searches Jessica's office for the Nussbaumer case, photographs her hands and takes her file on him. Nussbaumer once saved Defford's life, and she helps arrest Jessica at gunpoint.
stages.whoA: The suspect she arrests for Nussbaumer's murder
stages.whoB: A detective who arrests her for murder

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Defford and Imada question Trish outside the funeral home about Jessica and Nussbaumer. Trish accuses them of trying to pin the killing on Jessica.
stages.whoA: A grieving witness she questions about Jessica
stages.whoB: A detective who questions her about Jessica

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Imada leads the search of Jessica's office and questions her about Nussbaumer, then arrests her. When the killer strikes again, Imada frees her and asks her help to bring in the masked vigilante.
stages.whoA: The suspect she arrests, then frees
stages.whoB: The detective who arrests her, then frees her

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Imada asks Trish to fill in blanks in Jessica's story outside the funeral home. Trish accuses her of trying to pin Nussbaumer's death on Jessica.
stages.whoA: A grieving witness she questions about Jessica
stages.whoB: A detective who questions her about Jessica

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: On his mother's orders Dwayne drops Erik into the pool tied to weights over a short payment. When Erik comes back late, Dwayne throws him in again with three weights.
stages.whoA: The debtor he drowns for his mother
stages.whoB: Sal's son, who throws him in the pool

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: As Dwayne throws Erik into the pool again, a masked Trish storms the yard and beats him. He gets up to find his mother badly hurt.
stages.whoA: The masked woman who beats him
stages.whoB: The bookie's son she beats

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Mrs. De Luca greets Jessica at her old family home and shares stories of her childhood and old gossip with Kilgrave. Under Kilgrave's control she later carries a bomb to Simpson and dies.
stages.whoA: The neighbor girl she watched grow up
stages.whoB: Her family's old next-door neighbor

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Kilgrave invites Mrs. De Luca to breakfast, makes her admit she lies to feel important, and sends her away. He then orders her to hand Simpson his own bomb, and she dies in the blast.
stages.whoA: The man who controls her and sends her to die
stages.whoB: The neighbor he turns into a bomb

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Controlled by Kilgrave, Mrs. De Luca stops Simpson outside the Jones house and hands him a bag holding his own bomb. It goes off as he runs, killing her and his two men.
stages.whoA: The officer she brings Kilgrave's bomb
stages.whoB: The neighbor who brings him his bomb

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Gina picks Luke up at his bar and sleeps with him. Learning she is married, he turns her away, and her husband Andre brings his rugby team to beat Luke.
stages.whoA: The bar owner she has an affair with
stages.whoB: A married woman he sleeps with

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Gina storms Jessica's office over the photos of her with Luke and accuses her of chasing off the competition. Jessica grabs her arm, and Gina reveals Andre's team is on its way to Luke's bar.
stages.whoA: The investigator who photographed her affair
stages.whoB: Luke's married lover, who blames her

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Gor collects Brianna's cut on the street and grabs her for holding money back. He takes her out of Malcolm's apartment, then loses her when Malcolm beats him.
stages.whoA: A woman he runs on the street
stages.whoB: The pimp she works for

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Gor punches Malcolm and takes Brianna back out of his apartment. Malcolm later finds him on the street, beats him down and leaves with Brianna.
stages.whoA: The man who beats him and takes Brianna
stages.whoB: Brianna's pimp, whom he beats

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Grace co-hosts Trish's style program on ARN and plays along when Trish rambles about Mother's Day on air. After Dorothy's murder she welcomes Trish back and praises her strength.
stages.whoA: The star she co-hosts with on ARN
stages.whoB: Her co-host on ARN

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Dorothy warns Grace on set that her blouse shows too much. Later Trish brings Dorothy on air, and Grace welcomes her as a guest.
stages.whoA: Trish's mother, a guest on air
stages.whoB: Trish's co-host

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Jessica stops Spheeris's car by lifting it, and he threatens to tell the world about her. She mocks him with talk of laser eyes and serves him the subpoena.
stages.whoA: The strong woman who serves him
stages.whoB: A club owner she serves with a subpoena

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Griffin dates Trish and panics when she vanishes chasing IGH, then copies a list of names from her computer. He stages a surprise proposal, and she ends the relationship.
stages.whoA: The girlfriend he proposes to
stages.whoB: Her reporter boyfriend

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Griffin helps bail Jessica out and trades dark jokes with her, then turns to her when Trish goes missing. He lures her to his proposal party with a call saying Trish is in trouble.
stages.whoA: Trish's best friend
stages.whoB: Trish's boyfriend

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Griffin lunches with Trish and Dorothy, then enlists Dorothy to bring Trish to his surprise proposal.
stages.whoA: Trish's mother, who helps with his proposal
stages.whoB: Trish's boyfriend

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Inez trades scraps of IGH information for shelter at Jeri's home, then sells her the lie that Shane can heal her ALS. They become lovers until Inez and Shane rob Jeri, and Jeri tricks Inez into shooting Shane.
stages.whoA: The lawyer she seduces and robs
stages.whoB: The con artist she falls for

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Jessica tracks Inez down and learns she was an IGH nurse whose patient broke her back. Jessica arranges for Jeri to keep her safe.
stages.whoA: The investigator chasing IGH
stages.whoB: A former IGH nurse she protects

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Trish helps Jessica find Inez and hears her story of the IGH patient who nearly killed her.
stages.whoA: Jessica's sister, chasing IGH
stages.whoB: A former IGH nurse she helps find

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Inez runs from Malcolm and steals his television. He catches her trying to sell it and takes her to Jeri.
stages.whoA: The man who catches her and takes her to Jeri
stages.whoB: The nurse who steals his television

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Masked, Trish corners Montero at his building and beats a confession out of him. He admits his fires killed 14 people and dies under her blows.
stages.whoA: The masked vigilante who kills him
stages.whoB: An arsonist she beats to death

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Jessica visits Jack posing as a transit investigator. Unable to speak, he spells KIL to confirm Kilgrave, then writes a plea for her to kill him, which she refuses.
stages.whoA: The investigator who asks who took his kidneys
stages.whoB: Kilgrave's mute victim

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Jessica corners Justis on the golf course, and he refuses to give up Malus. She then confronts his son Eric, and Justis agrees to tell her where Malus is.
stages.whoA: The investigator who threatens his son
stages.whoB: Malus's loyal patron

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Justis pays Malus's bills out of gratitude for saving his son. After Jessica's visit he calls to warn Malus about her.
stages.whoA: The doctor who saved his son
stages.whoB: The old friend who pays his bills

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Trish sings at Kyle's daughter's birthday party in exchange for a hospital file. Kyle hands over the pages he copied on Jessica, all he could find.
stages.whoA: The star who sings for his daughter
stages.whoB: The hospital guard who trades her a file

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Laurent turns Jeri away after his father's death and knocks her down, then apologizes. Later he comes to her office and asks her to protect his mother from the lawsuits.
stages.whoA: The lawyer he blames, then asks for help
stages.whoB: Kith's son

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Luke beats up Sirkes's men, then talks Sirkes into a finder's deal for Antoine. At the warehouse Sirkes gets Luke in a headlock, but Luke throws a table at him and his men.
stages.whoA: The strongman who cuts a deal, then beats him
stages.whoB: The loan shark Antoine owes

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Jessica mocks Sirkes as a would-be Carl Icahn while Luke strikes a deal. At the warehouse she refuses to hand Antoine over and fights off his men.
stages.whoA: The investigator hired to find Antoine
stages.whoB: A loan shark she defies

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Dr. Hansen works under Malus at IGH as he treats Alisa. She worries about Alisa's rages and tries to sedate her, but Malus sends her out.
stages.whoA: The IGH scientist she works under
stages.whoB: A doctor on his IGH team

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Inez is a new nurse at IGH when her patient Alisa throws her into a glass cabinet and breaks her back. Alisa then kills Luanne, the other nurse.
stages.whoA: The IGH patient who broke her back
stages.whoB: A nurse she nearly killed at IGH

dropped.why: His name is never said in any of his five episodes (S1E4, E6, E9, E10, E11 transcripts) and nothing shown names him; 'Jackson' comes only from the credits.

changes.was: Hospital guard Kyle trades copied IGH files for Trish singing at his daughter's birthday party.
changes.now: Hospital guard Kyle trades a copied hospital file on Jessica for Trish singing at his daughter's birthday party.
changes.why: Kyle copies Jessica's hospital records (missing 20 days after the accident), not IGH files; IGH is only Trish's theory about the file.
Only 'Laurent' is said when he first appears (S3E6); the full name 'Laurent Lyonne' is first said in S3E9, so the name is staged.

changes.was: Trish sings at Kyle's daughter's birthday party in exchange for a hospital file. Kyle hands over the IGH pages he copied, all he could find.
changes.now: Trish sings at Kyle's daughter's birthday party in exchange for a hospital file. Kyle hands over the pages he copied on Jessica, all he could find.
changes.why: The file is Jessica's hospital record, not IGH pages.

changes.now: Inez Green | Alisa Jones (enemy, Jessica Jones S2, ep 7)
changes.why: Important tie missing: Inez and Alisa share the IGH scene where Alisa throws her and kills Luanne, the attack Inez describes in S2E4 and that defines her story.
